title: feat(objectql, runtime)!: object-less action names held per namespace, and a call that names no package is refused when two holders answer it (ADR-0150 child B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Ks66R81SMbqErh2M5S611u)_

Fixes #31697

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — a call that names no package is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, naming every holder, where it ran one of them on base: `ObjectQL.executeAction` with no `packageId` while two code owners hold a handler under one `object:name`; the bare `POST /actions/:object/:action` and the MCP bare `run_action` while two packages declare one action on one object, or a package's declaration stands beside an owner-less one the environment's store does not hold; `GET /meta/action/NAME` with no `?package=` while two packages hold an object-less action of the name. First-party count: 0 (census below). The install side widens: two packages of two namespaces may each declare one object-less action name (the package door, the item seam and the cold-boot seal accept the second).
Metadata-protocol: added
Narrowing: yes — the refusals above; measured first-party 0 on showcase, crm and multi-package (census table).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：无对象动作（object-less action）的同名规则从「全环境一个持有者」收窄为「每个命名空间一个」；不写包名的调用（引擎 `executeAction`、裸 REST `/actions/:object/:action`、MCP 裸 `run_action`、`/meta/action/NAME`）遇到两个持有者时返回 409 并列出全部持有者，不再按注册或列出顺序挑一个。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 child B 的 action 卡；史诗裁决 6729825528 字母 A（同对象同名两包，裸调用 409）和 G2 义务 6742974046（无主宿主声明是平台持有者，不是环境）都在这张卡里落地。
- 风险与回滚：这是收窄，首方计数为 0（showcase、crm、multi-package 三个组合实测无一对同名持有者、无无主声明）；回滚就是 revert 本 PR，裸调用恢复为「最后注册者执行」。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine-actions.ts`（`unqualifiedHandler`、`codeOwnerOf`）、`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`（`pickActionHolder`、`bareRouteHolderRefusal`、`environmentStoredActionNames`）、`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts` 的开关数组。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-request-family.test.ts src/bound-action-collision-report.test.ts`，以及 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/actions-addressed-route.test.ts src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`，应全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位审阅后落地；B 卡按「谁先评审通过、CI 全绿谁先落」，落地前 merge origin/main 并保留开关数组里各方条目。

## What changes

- **The switch.** `'action'` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` in `packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`. The module doc's action bullet moves to the past tense and "The narrowing" gains a paragraph for #31697. Only the object-less action is a holder (`holdsBareName`); an action bound to an object was never covered and is unchanged.
- **The engine** (`engine-actions.ts`). `executeAction` with no `packageId` goes through `ActionsFacet.unqualifiedHandler(key)`: it reads each package coordinate's slot, takes the slot's code owner (`codeOwnerOf`: the handler's own owner, or, under an environment-authored handler, the code owner beneath it), and throws `UnqualifiedActionHandlerAmbiguityError` (409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `owners`) when two or more differ. The environment's resync (`metadata-service`) is never a second owner. One owner answers exactly as before. A call that names a package is unchanged. The `registerAction` replacement warning now says the second owner makes a no-package call refused.
- **The REST bare door** (`resolveRouteActionDeclaration`, no caller package). Before the rungs, `bareRouteHolderRefusal` reads the same declarations the MCP bridge and the addressed door read (`collectActionDeclarations` over the protocol's merged object and action listings), bound to the routed object first, object-less after. Two or more holders answer `pickActionHolder`'s refusal; zero or one falls through to the rungs unchanged.
- **The MCP bare call** (`resolveActionByName`). An object-bound pair now goes through `pickActionHolder` like the object-less one did (it answered `hits[0]`).
- **`/meta/action/NAME`** (`readMetaItem`, no `packageId`). The registry's new `refuseAmbiguousObjectLessAction(name)` runs `resolveActionByPackage` for the object-less key with no caller and throws its refusal. An action bound to an object reads through `getItem` as before.
- **Owner-less declarations** (G2 obligation 6742974046). See the section below.

## Owner-less declarations: option (b), classified by source

Seat ruling: classify by the row's source, not by `_provenance` bytes (definition bytes are caller-writable, #31850 review). This PR takes **option (b)**.

- `environmentStoredActionNames(ql)` reads the environment's own store, the read the engine plugin's authored-action resync makes: active `sys_metadata` rows of type `action` and `object` whose `package_id` is null or empty.
- `packagelessOriginOf(hits, store)` marks a package-less declaration as the environment's only when the store holds it (a standalone row by its name, an embedded row by its object's name). It reads the store only when a package-less declaration stands beside another holder, the one case where the answer changes.
- Every other package-less declaration is the **platform's** (`platformItem` in the core resolver, R2's owner-less function). Alone it answers. Beside a package holder the name is refused naming both ("the platform (registered by a plugin or the host, owned by no package)").
- Pinned: a host row carrying `_provenance: 'org'` is still the platform's (`actions-addressed-route.test.ts`, "the definition's bytes never make a host row the environment's"), with an ablation that classifies by those bytes and turns the pin red.
- Where it came from, measured first (census below): 0 owner-less rows in showcase, crm and multi-package.

## Census (step 0, booted in-process at base 48f18b58; probe not committed)

| composition | declaration rows | (object, name) keys with 2+ holders | owner-less rows | handler keys | keys with 2+ handler coordinates |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| showcase | 148 | 0 | 0 | 62 | 0 |
| crm | 68 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| multi-package (crm namespace co-owners) | 67 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 |

`BUILT_IN_BARE_NAMES.action`: census 0. No platform code requests an object-less action by a fixed name (`git grep` over `packages/**/src` and `ui/**/src` for `executeAction('global'…`, `/actions/global/NAME`, `registerAction('global'…`: no hit outside comments and tests). The set stays empty; a pin asserts the size and that a built-in name is still refused when one is added.

## The positions

| Position | Before | After | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Two namespaces' packages hold one object-less action name | refused (422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`) | **installed**, boots with no warning | registry "the narrowing" (two namespaces install, item seam, cold boot); dogfood boot + install-local `zeta` |
| A co-owner of the holder's namespace | refused | refused | registry matrix (co-owner rival) + "a co-owner … naming only its own namespace's holder"; dogfood `alphamod` (the override write gate answers first, see Deviations) |
| A package with no namespace (either side) | refused | refused | registry "a package with no namespace…" |
| Two packages of `base`, `system`, `sys` | refused | refused (not widened) | registry `it.each(['base','system','sys'])` |
| A built-in name | refused | refused | registry "a built-in name is still refused…" |
| An API and a function | refused | refused | registry "CONTROL — an API has not narrowed", the API rows of the matrix |
| Bare engine call, two code owners on one key | last registration ran | **409** naming every owner | `bound-action-collision-report.test.ts`, `plugin-authored-actions.test.ts`, runtime `action-package-addressing.test.ts` |
| Bare REST / MCP call, same object, two packages | the object's own ran | **409** naming both | `actions-addressed-route.test.ts` (crm + hr `lead.convert`) |
| Bare REST / MCP, host row beside a package | the environment's (first) ran | **409** naming the package and the platform | `actions-addressed-route.test.ts` (G2 block) |
| Bare REST / MCP, environment-stored row beside a package | the environment's | the environment's (unchanged, D3) | `actions-addressed-route.test.ts` CONTROL |
| `/meta/action/NAME`, two packages' object-less action | first registered served | **409** naming both; `?package=` reaches each | runtime `action-package-addressing.test.ts`; dogfood |
| `/meta/action/NAME`, two packages' actions bound to two objects | `getItem` | `getItem` (unchanged) | runtime CONTROL |

## Acceptance notes

- 对象绑定的同名读不在本卡范围 (seat ruling Q1 = A): `/meta/action/NAME` refuses only when two or more packages hold an OBJECT-LESS action of the name. Two packages' actions of one name bound to objects still read through `getItem`. No follow-up card.
- `_env` still reaches a host-code (platform) row, as on base (seat ruling Q4): `/actions/_env/...` and `run_action{namespace:'_env'}` read every package-less declaration as the environment's. First-party count of such rows: 0.
- Cost (seat ruling Q3, kept): the bare REST door now reads the protocol's merged object and action listings on every bare action call, as MCP and the addressed door already do, so all doors judge one set of declarations. When a package-less declaration stands beside another holder it also reads two `sys_metadata` lists (`type: action`, `type: object`, active). The MCP bare call reads the same store under the same condition.

## Deviations

- **A listing that throws judges nothing** (`bareRouteHolderRefusal`). The first draft answered `503` when the merged listing read threw. On fixtures whose engine has no metadata store (30 runtime tests in 9 files: `dispatcher-unique-violation-wire-code`, `sandbox-plain-object-throw-client-sentence` and others) that turned a working bare call into a 503. Now the pre-check returns nothing and the rungs answer as before. Nothing is served from the failed read, and the engine still refuses a no-package call while two code owners hold the handler. A store read that throws while it is needed (an owner-less declaration beside another holder) is still `degraded`.
- **Dogfood co-owner refusal** comes from the override write gate (ADR-0146 D2, `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`), not the one-holder door: a co-owner depends on the holder, so a same-named item is "a dependent replacing a base item" and is refused first. The one-holder door's own co-owner refusal is pinned in-process. The case "a package declaring the held action and the showcase's API name" is now refused for the API alone.
- **Claim line.** The claim says `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Narrowing: no`. Seat ruling Q2 replaced it with the lines above; the claim correction on #31697 is the seat's to post (a card thread posts no claim).

## Forced test changes

- `packages/objectql/src/bound-action-collision-report.test.ts`: "replaces the handler — the last registration runs — and warns naming both owners" becomes the 409 assertion (the warning half is unchanged); "[#31697 interim] a call that names no package keeps today's answer exactly" becomes "[#31697] … is refused (409) naming both packages", plus a new case for host code and a plugin beside a package, with an environment CONTROL.
- `packages/objectql/src/plugin-authored-actions.test.ts`: "[#30542] a registration with no package under an armed override replaces it and is warned" now expects the no-package call refused naming `app:<base>` and host code; the base's own address still runs the override.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-request-family.test.ts`: the matrix's rival for `action` was a package of another namespace, which is now admitted; it becomes a co-owner of `alpha`'s namespace (as #31973 did for agent and skill), so every refusal assertion still runs with the co-owner's rename. The bound-action CONTROL's object-less rival and the reason test's second package become co-owners for the same reason.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`: "the switch holds agent and skill" asserted the set equals `['agent', 'skill']`; it now includes `action`.
- `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`: the "[#31697 interim]" describe flips to the refusal (declaration and dispatch), with a one-holder CONTROL.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions-addressed-route.test.ts`: "the bare call keeps its answer, the object's own (crm's) … flip these when it lands" flips to REST 409 and MCP refusal naming crm and hr.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-request-family.dogfood.test.ts`: the cold-boot warning no longer names the object-less action; install-local `delta` is refused for the API alone; new cases for the bare refusals, the addressed calls, a co-owner and a third namespace.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts`: packages A and B also declare the object-less action `m31693_digest` in their own namespaces; the `sealedClashes` assertion (the picklist only) pins that the S4 report does not list it.

## Overlap and landing order

The B siblings (#31696, #31698 PR-2, #31699 PR 1 #32089) share one array with this PR: `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (and its doc) in `bare-name-one-holder.ts`, plus the switch pin in `registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`. Seat 1 relaxed the order to whichever is reviewed and green first. Before landing I merge `origin/main` (no rebase, no force-push) and keep every sibling's entry in the set.
